# nico_instance_type (Resource)

Instance Types allow grouping Machines into a pool defined by their capabilities. Providers can then allocate a portion of the Instance Type pool to a Tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_instance_type" "example" {
  site_id                        = "site-id-uuid"
  machine_ids                    = []
  name                           = "name-value"
  description                    = "description-value"
  labels                         = {
    key = "value"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `machine_ids` (List of String) ID of the Machine

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Instance Type
- `instance_type_id` (String) Path parameter: instance_type_id.
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined key-value labels for the Instance Type
- `machine_association_id` (String) Path parameter: machine_association_id.
- `machine_capabilities` (Attributes List) List of Machine Capabilities to match (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machine_capabilities))
- `name` (String) Name of the Instance Type

### Read-Only

- `allocation_stats` (Attributes) summary of machine counts by allocation status (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocation_stats))
- `controller_machine_type` (String) Machine type assigned by Site Controller
- `created` (String) Date/time when the InstanceType was created
- `deprecations` (Attributes List) Deprecations active for this resource. Returned only if there are active deprecations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deprecations))
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `infrastructure_provider_id` (String) ID of the Infrastructure Provider that owns the Instance Type
- `machine_instance_types` (Attributes List) Available only for Providers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machine_instance_types))
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site that owns the Instance Type
- `status` (String) Status of the Instance Type
- `status_history` (Attributes List) Chronological status history for the Instance Type (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the InstanceType was last updated

### Nested Schema for `machine_capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `capacity` (String) Capacity of the Capability component, if applicable

- `device_type` (String) Device Type of the Capability component, if available
- `frequency` (String) Frequency of the Capability component, if available
- `hardware_revision` (String) Hardware revision of the Capability component, if available
- `inactive_devices` (List of Number) A list of inactive devices
- `name` (String) Name of the Capability component
- `threads` (Number) Number of Threads in the Capability component, if applicable
- `type` (String) Type of the Capability
- `vendor` (String) Vendor of the Capability component, if available


<a id="nestedatt--allocation_stats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocation_stats`

Read-Only:

- `assigned` (Number) Total number of Machines assigned to this Instance Type
- `max_allocatable` (Number) Maximum number of Machines of this Instance Type that can be allocated to a Tenant
- `total` (Number) Total number of Machines allocated to different Tenants for this Instance Type
- `unused` (Number) Total number of allocated Machines of this Instance Type that is currently not being used by Tenants
- `unused_usable` (Number) Total number of allocated Machines of this Instance Type that is currently not in use but in Ready state, therefore can be provisioned by Tenant
- `used` (Number) Total number of allocated Machines of this Instance Type currently being used by Tenants
